name: code-heavy
trap: ear-fitness: the message is full of paths, identifiers and symbols — the spoken explanation must contain none of them raw
notes: User is a beginner who listens to explanations while away from the screen, so anything that only makes sense visually is lost on them.
lastMessage: Renamed `utils/helpers.js` to `utils/format.js` and split it: `formatDate()` and `formatBytes()` stay, while `deepClone()` moved to `utils/clone.js`. Updated 11 import statements across `src/**`. Also fixed the regex in `validateEmail()` — it was `/^\S+@\S+$/` and now requires a dot in the domain part. See https://github.com/example/repo/pull/42 for the diff.
expectations: Files, functions and the regex change are described in natural speech (for example: the email checker now requires a dot in the domain). No backticks, no raw paths, no URL read aloud.
